estimate.note: GADS canonical (agrees across BOTH engines): cloud found -1021.94, local independently found -1021.9390 — matching to 4 decimal places, almost certainly because both called the same deterministic native gads_causal_estimate_ate(treatment='trainees', outcome='earnings', confounders=['age']) rather than each hand-deriving a regression. OPPOSITE SIGN from the QRData gold (+2457.89, computed via a matching estimator, not regression-adjustment). Not scored against a tolerance — this is a genuine sign-flip divergence between estimators, not an error; see notes.md. Naive unadjusted difference was -4555.74 in both framings' direction (trainees earn less), so both analyses agree the raw comparison is confounded — they disagree on what adjusting for it reveals, and now do so identically regardless of engine.
